_source: The club, 6 and 12 September 2026, by shirt number. Leon Burnett added 28 October 2026, from the club. Andrew Allen and Dean Knight corrected the same day: both are wing backs, and they are on the opposite sides to the full-back entries this file carried for them since September. Neither is named at a position in any stored team sheet, so the club's statement is the only evidence there is.
_note:
WHERE THE CLUB SAYS SOMEBODY PLAYS, when that differs from where the archive shows they lined up. Inference reads team sheets, which is the right answer for a player with a season behind him and the wrong one when a man has been moved: Jon Lloyd spent 25/26 at left wing back and is a forward this season, and no amount of reading last year's sheets will say so.

IT LOSES TO THE PANEL. A position stated on the player's own record wins over this file, so the club correcting somebody in Control panel -> Squad and staff overrides it and this entry can then be deleted. Same rule as every other *-extra.json here: the file is the stopgap and the database is the record.
_replaceWhen: Delete an entry once the same position is set on that player in the control panel.
